title: feat(plugin-detail,app-shell,components): record page v3 layout
body:
Part of #27055 — this lands the record page v3 layout. The two fenced read points stay for #27069: the related cards' default order (primary first, then derived order, without reading `relatedLists`) and the body tables' placement (after the first field group, without a `fieldGroups` placement entry).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：没有指定页面的对象，记录页换成 v3 布局。详情区无边框，空区段折成一行。时间线合成一条流，带「全部/活动/讨论/变更」筛选。关联区是紧凑卡片，读者可拖动、折叠、隐藏，还能 ⤢ 原地放大。主从子表直接嵌在详情里。
- 为什么改：执行 #27055 已批准的 v3 设计。删掉了 ADR-0085 判死的页面开关和 rightRail 插槽，把三处重复的历史、动态、讨论入口并成一个。
- 风险与回滚：只改渲染层，作者写的元数据不变。BuildPageOptions 删字段属于 TS 层面的破坏性变更，控制台内部没有调用方传这些字段。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。读者的卡片排列存在已有的 workspacePreference 里，回滚后不会被读取，没有副作用。
- 先看：ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx（放大的 URL 往返、排列偏好、字段变更并入时间线），ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/relatedArrangement.ts（排列合并规则），ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordPageColumns.tsx（三栏模板和放大视图）。
- 两分钟验证：打开下方证据分支里的 contact-1440-three-columns.png，应看到「详情｜时间线｜关联卡片」三栏，时间线里有一条灰色的字段变更行和两条评论。
- 需要你做的：人工评审并合并。本 PR 改动 5828 行，超过 3000 行的人工合并线。

## What changes

The synthesized default record page (an object with no assigned record page) takes the v3 layout. Authored pages are untouched apart from the shared header and the renderer faces noted below.

- **Header.** One filled primary action, two outline actions, the rest in `⋯`. Refresh is the first item of `⋯` (no separate ⟳ button). Up to six highlights, as an equal grid.
- **Details.** Frameless sections in one to three columns. All-empty sections fold into one line at the foot. The created / updated / owner / id line closes the details column.
- **Timeline.** One stream merging comments, `sys_activity` rows and audit field changes, newest first. The composer is on top, the chips are All / Activity / Discussion / Changes, system entries are one muted line, and a "View all N →" button shows the rest. The History tab, the Activity tab and the discussion footer are retired on this page.
- **Related column.** Compact cards (title, count, ＋, ⤢, up to three rows of name plus one chip, no table header, no View All footer) in a fixed 320 px column. The columns are 1.25fr : 1fr : 320px.
- **Reader arrangement.** Drag (desktop), Move up / Move down / Collapse / Hide from the card menu, and "N hidden · Show" at the foot. It is stored in the #27052 workspace preference under `record.related.arrangement`, scope `object:<name>`. The value is `{ v, order, collapsed, hidden, basedOn, seen }`. A default-order change shows "Default order updated · Restore default". A new relationship lands after its nearest default neighbour with a "New" badge for 48 hours. The tabbed tier's Related tab follows the same arrangement.
- **Enlarge in place.** ⤢ opens the list full width under `?related=<object>.<field>`. Esc or ‹ Back returns.
- **Body tables.** A `master_detail` FK declaring `inlineEdit`, or `relatedList: 'primary'`, is drawn as a table after the first field group. It opens on ten rows with a totals line and has ⤢.
- **Tabbed tier** (drawer, narrow widths): Details / Timeline / Related / (Approvals). Timeline is second for an object whose timeline is on by default (#27052's derivation), last otherwise. Attachments sit in Related.
- **BuildPageOptions** loses `hideHighlights`, `hidePath`, `showReferenceRail`, `hideReferenceRail`, `hideRelatedTab`, `relatedLayout`, `recordChrome`, `showActivity`, `history` and `slots.rightRail` (TypeScript-only break, named in the changeset with its ADR-0087 marker).

Fence read points for #27069:

- **Default order.** `synthParts` related ordering in `RecordDetailView.tsx`, commented as the fence.
- **Body-table placement.** `bodyTablePlacement` in `buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`, commented as the fence.

## Tests

- New suites cover the face, the arrangement merge rules, the card stack (drag, menu, collapse, hide, enlarge, tabbed tier), body tables, body-table placement, and the timeline stream including its newest-first window. A last suite pins the retired hints as compile errors.
- Existing pins moved with the page: History and discussion-footer reads now open the Timeline tab, the header menu has Refresh first, the highlight cap is six, and the meta line sits in the details column.

## Acceptance notes

- **Screenshots** are on the never-merged branch `claude/issue-27055-evidence-20261028`: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/tree/claude/issue-27055-evidence-20261028/evidence/27055
  - Shots: contact 1440 three columns, contact 1100 two columns, contact drawer, account 1440, opportunity 1440, related column after a drag, and the enlarged state.
  - There is no product object in this repo, so the opportunity (with its Line Items body table) stands in.
- **Three columns at 1440** need the app sidebar collapsed. The tier threshold (1280 px page container, #26678) is unchanged.
- **Accounts and contacts** fold the timeline by #27052's object-derived default. The shots turn the reader's switch on; the switch semantics are unchanged.
- **Deviations:**
  - The arrangement value carries a `seen` member, a first-seen stamp per id, as the clock for the 48-hour "New" badge.
  - Body-table totals are a summary line over the page's rows, not an in-table row.
  - Body-table collapse is per view, not persisted.
  - The host's Edit stays a labelled filled button outside the three-action cap.
  - The enlarged list keeps the full list page's "View All" link, for sort, filter and export. Only the card footer is gone.
- **Out of scope, carrier #27069:**
  - The spec describe of `relatedList: 'primary'` still says "promoted to its own tab".
  - The spec describe of `enable.trackHistory` still says "Show the record History tab".
  - The generated reference docs repeat both describes.
  - These live under `packages/spec/**`, which this card does not touch. The hand-written security doc line is updated here.

## Verification

- **Gates.** Every gate `dispatch-gates.mjs --changed` derives for this diff ran on the final tree. The `--ran` reconciliation verdict is below.
- **Console type-check.** It fails locally only on plugin packages outside the build closure (`plugin-gantt`, `plugin-map`, `plugin-markdown`, `plugin-timeline`, `plugin-tree` have no `dist` here). No error is in a file this PR touches. CI builds the full graph.
- **Browser.** Checked in a real browser against the app-crm example on a fresh database. The console dev server ran from this branch.
